title: The storage panel: drive use and the sets that fit under the target
caption: The lab volume's and the owner's home's use as spine-datasets' feed read them, every set the feed knows with its size, licence and state, and the choices (keep, remove, add, place on the lab or the home) that build a selection the planner's check admits under the target; the interactive figure trials combinations and asks for the changes only through storage.yml, whose run opens a request pull request the owner merges.

source.notes: Drawn from a committed snapshot of OpenSpineConsortium/spine-datasets's PLAN.json on its branch storage-feed, built 2026-10-24T20:52:07Z from that repository's records, with the lab volume read 2026-10-24T17:15:28Z by the grid's status word; the snapshot's sha256 is fcdd7bfe2cacd74283b0b4318044f5c777c2816782d352d0129e50dad81b6792. The sizes are the feed's own, measured where a set is frozen and stated by its source otherwise, and the home's use is null until a grid word reads it. .github/workflows/docs.yml refreshes the snapshot with the App's read token before each site build and builds the page from the committed snapshot when the feed is unreachable; a reading is dated, never a final value, and the page shows its age.

explore.label: The snapshot of the feed it draws from

rerun.cost: CPU, a second: it redraws the page from the committed snapshot, which docs.yml refreshes from the feed before each site build
